criteria.kill_pool: original/background_only/historical_reference cells at each observed frame with exact H, excluding anchor cell and deduplicating same control cell; per-frame median comparator equal frame weight, not path-length weight
criteria.kill_min_support: at least3 distinct finite paired observed frames in EACH of five sequences, F>=5; recency/recent additionally H>=1; run/episodes additionally H>=2 to exclude degeneracy
criteria.kill_direction: one individual quantity must have nonzero median contrast with SAME sign in all five, with >=2/3 paired frames having that sign in every sequence; both+and- allowed, no combinations/selection of windows/bins
criteria.kill_action: if no individual quantity meets this fixed rule: E18 occupancy sufficient AT CURRENT EVIDENCE LEVEL; DO_NOT_PROPOSE_E21_BACKGROUND_MODEL; unsupported comparisons UNKNOWN, not proven mathematical sufficiency

interpretation: insufficient support is UNKNOWN, not zero effect; decision is evidence-level adequacy, not mathematical sufficiency; no E21 implementation
